note: Human rulings that the reconciliation report cannot safely infer. Everything here is a claim that two names are the same movement, or that a token means another token — the kind of judgement a string comparison must never make on its own.

equipment_new.note: Tokens with no equivalent in content.equipment. `tier` is a PROPOSAL for review: athlete_selectable becomes an onboarding control, derived_common is implied by a gym rather than ticked, specialized needs deliberate opt-in and never a backfill. PRODUCT RULING (2026-08-31): machine and hurdle moved to specialized; the other ten accepted as proposed.

machine.why: Too broad to drive hard eligibility: one checkbox would imply a leg-extension machine, a chest-supported row and a lat-pulldown station alike. Specialized for V1 until machine types are split or facility-level equipment bundles exist.

hurdle.why: Two exercises. Asking every athlete about hurdles at onboarding is friction for almost no coverage; box jump, broad jump and lateral bound cover normal plyometric programming.

bucket_normalisation.note: The 50/25/25 bucket answers 'what kind of exposure is this'. Anchor-ness answers 'how should the progression engine treat it' and belongs in progression_class. Six values collapse to the methodology's three; the anchor half of each label is carried out separately as a proposed progression_class. PRODUCT RULING (2026-08-31): the implication is accepted — a row bucketed as an accessory anchor is progression_class accessory_anchor. Recorded here as an explicit rule rather than derived silently, which is the distinction product asked for: the bucket says what kind of exposure a movement is, the class says how the progression engine treats it, and one may only set the other where someone has said so.

renames.note: Proposed RENAME_EXISTING: the sheet's preferred display name for a movement the library already has. The id is preserved; only the canonical name changes, and the old name becomes an alias.

keep_existing.note: Live exercises absent from the sheet that are NOT deprecation candidates. Cardio, mobility and skill work is out of scope for a strength vocabulary, so its absence carries no signal at all. The six named by product are kept deliberately: five are endpoints in the substitution graph and push_press -> incline_db_press is what makes HYROX Push A reachable without a barbell.

progression_class_overrides.note: Rows where the source sheet's class is wrong and product corrected it directly. Accessory anchors are progressively overloadable but must not carry the capability-inference weight of a squat or a deadlift, which is the whole reason the class exists.

create_as.note: The proposed name is review shorthand, not the name to create. Each entry gives the canonical name and any aliases the discarded wording should survive as, so terminology stays searchable without minting a second identity for it.

Cable / Machine Fly.why: no generic machine equipment; author a machine-specific fly separately if ever needed

Pistol Squat / Single-Leg Squat.why: single-leg-squat is family language, not a separate canonical
